method.command_semantics: scaled policy position contribution before constant default offset and actuator delay; step changes are not actual joint-angle jumps
method.episode_selection: largest observed hip mirror residual in 1.0..1.5s; includes censored tails where this window was observed
method.limits: descriptive one-seed data; does not establish intervention causality
method.position_action_order: right hip then left hip; preserve_order=True
